nom: SickScience Labs ShapeShift Advanced Jaw & Neck Firming Serum

avis.texte: I have been using this product for about a year because it actually works ! So happy its now at Ulta !
I purchased Shapeshift in April and I am stunned at how well it has already worked. My jawline is more defined and my neck looks firm and lifted. Highly recommend.

I have been using Shapeshift for over a year and love it. Happy I can now purchase via Utla and not online. It is a bit expensive but do not need a lot per application. My neck feels smooth and the jawline softer

I'm turning 50 this year and have also lost a significant amount of weight recently. I noticed that I was starting to get a loose neck. I started using this product and saw results almost immediately. I can be a harsh critic, so I was super impressed. Definitely recommend!

I started using this last fall and could see a difference along my jawline and under my chin after just a few days. Then we went out of town for 10 days and I left it at home—by the time we came back, i could see things were going back to the way they had been. I've been using it regularly ever since and definitely appreciate the changes…skin looks tighter and more firm. Will definitely keep using this!
Luv this cream! I wear it everyday and see a marked difference with my neck. I have started to give this as a gift to my friends and they love it as well
Just started using this product. My neck skin is smooth and will look for positive results over the next weeks.
Have not seen any difference yet and have been using every day twice a day for over 2 weeks
Too early to see results but I love the texture of this serum. It goes on so smoothly and absorbs quickly. Undetectable under make up. Looking forward to seeing results in the coming weeks!

I have had my ShapeShift for less than two weeks, yet I got an email asking me to review it. All I can say is that while I haven't seen a difference yet, I assume that I will. Until that time, I'll give it 3 stars for not irritating my skin.
Feels nice when applied but it's only been 2 weeks so am not seeing any results yet. Hopeful it will work.
Shapeshifter offers a lifting and tightening of the neck and jaw. Worth the price and the effort.

Can definitely tell that this has helped lift my face around the jawline. It does what it says it will do. Think mine lasted 15 weeks using it twice a day, morning & night. That's almost 4 months. So definitely worth it.

I recently decided to try ShapeShift from SickScience. I was skeptical as I have tried many products from drugstore to LaMer and have never noticed any change. Within a few weeks of trying ShapeShift I did notice a difference. I have continued to use this product 2x day as possible but will soon change to the recommended 1x day. I recommend trying knowing that different products work for different people
I have been using ShapeShift for several months and can see a real improvement in my jawline. I am on ppauto delivery a will continue to use this product faithfully.

avis.titre: Customer for nearly 1 year - i see the difference!
avis.texte: Been using since last spring and I absolutely see a difference in my jawline. Will never stop using shapeshift!
Makes my skin feel very soft, & I can already see a difference in my skin's integrity.

Can't say enough about this product!! I just wish I had taken before pictures. I have been on a weight loss journey and this has been my holy grail!! Thank you Sick Science, you will have a customer for life ❤️

I have noticed Im needing more firming products in my skincare routine and got lucky when i saw a review on cnn about this. I have targeted my next lines multiple times hardly seeing a change. A week in and they're nearly gone. Wow!

Have been using shape shift for almost a year, it really does help tighten up the jaw line and really reduces the appearance of turkey neck also has no negative reaction to led light therapy ( before or after application) and I have super sensitive skin have never once had a issue with shape shift.

Very gradual improvement has occurred on my jawline using ShapeShift. It's easy to apply(I use the back side of my hands to sweep it up my jawline) I will keep using the product to see what happens with continuing use.

avis.titre: Just got and LOVE so far
avis.texte: I just bought this from Ulta 2 weeks or so ago and I already think I see a difference. I LOVE this stuff. It goes on really nicely. I saw it on the Today Show but forgot to buy it, I'm so excited to see it's in Ulta now! Not much like it out there

I purchased this product with high hopes for my jaw line and this item more than delivered. Not only have I seen an improvement in my jaw line look I used it on my laugh lines and they are all but non-visible anymore!! This is a must buy.

I waited to give a review of this product as I wanted to see if it would work. Here is what I have to say: I've used it only on my jawline and neck, and while my jawline still sags, my neckline is tighter. It is less wrinkled and more tightened in that area - essentially more sleek and smooth. I would definitely give it a try if you would like to tighten/smoothen your neckline. I would give it 4.5 stars, if I could.

It's only been a couple weeks since I started using this product, but I do think it's helping firm the skin on my neck. The texture of my skin on my neck and chin does seem to be smoother. Excited to keep using this!

avis.titre: Exosomes are the next big thing!
avis.texte: Only been using for about a month, hence the 4 stars. But I can see a difference and look forward to using it longer. Exosomes are just coming into their own. Also use another brand that is way more expensive. I really appreciate the effects of this at the price point!

I recently lost almost 50 pounds any my waddle has really aged me. After three months (yes, give it that long to decide), I see progress. I don't think there's anything to be done that isn't surgical for the large folds that are hanging, but the finer lines and loose skin have definitely improved. I did place another order to maintain the improvements.

I was skeptical at first as I am over 60, & my neck is beginning to age. I have been using it everyday for the past year & see a difference. I look better in pictures & makes me feel less self conscious. Love it!
I've lost weight and I know this product has helped keep my skin looking the best and firm! I wish I had before and during pictures!

I've tried many products for tightening and lifting and this one actually works! I have noticed a significant difference in my jawline and neck. I will continue to use this product as I age and recommend it to everyone who wonders why my jawline and neck look so young!
I love how this feels on my skin! its very refreshing. Highly recommend!
This product surprised even my aesthetician. At my most recent facial she told me that my neck & jaw looked better than hers! This one is a keeper. ❤️
After great results with DropOff, I decided to try ShapeShift. While I have only been using for about 3 weeks I am already seeing improvement. Truly happy with products from Sick Science.

I've been using ShapeShift for almost 3 weeks, morning and at bedtime. I swear I see a slight tightening under my chin and neck! Applying the serum twice a day fits easily into my daily routine. It absorbs quickly without leaving any tacky residue. So far, I'm very pleased with the results!

i had high hopes for this product based on what i've heard (reviews and Today show). maybe too high for a 55 year old neck--it's one of those "i think it helps? not totally sure." it's been about 3 weeks of use, thought i'd see more change by now.

avis.titre: Too early for me to know if anything is happening?
avis.texte: I would love to give it 5 stars, but I don't notice any changes yet. Goes on smoothly, though, so that is nice!
Have only been using g two weeks so nothing appearance wise yet; however the skin feels different. Softer and smoother.
I have no idea the results since I just got this at the beginning of the month and the product is gone! Thought it would last longer! Disappointing!

It goes on silky and absorbs quickly. Best of all I do think I'm seeing a difference already!! Have only been using it for just two weeks and can't wait to see results the longer I use it. Will definitely be getting another bottle.
Only used for a couple of weeks but I haven't noticed anything. I had high hopes. Could be too soon to tell.
I was skeptical, but noticed very positive results in just 1 week! Very happy!
I've been using this for a while. No change. So expensive and not worth it!!
Best thing I have tried for my neck area. I am loving the results.

I have used the ShapeShift product faithfully for two weeks. No result yet. Maybe too soon? I've also used the PowerCycle Hair Growth Serum for three weeks with no noticeable results. Again, too soon? I'll keep trying.
I'm on my second order and Love what I see. It does help and I'll take the help. Firmer chin and skin.
I can't say I'm seeing drastic or amazing results. My jawline looks a little bit tighter but not snatched the way I was hoping. I plan to keep using and hopefully the results get better.
I have always hated my under chin area of my face. Once I started this I saw improvement almost immediately. So far, love this product!

I've only been using ShapeShift for a week, and my jawline and neck already look tighter. I'm 70 years old and I have thin sensitive skin, but I had no issues with this serum. I will definitely recommend ShapeShift to friends and family.

avis.titre: I have been using this for a couple of weeks...
avis.texte: And I already see a subtle change. I'm going to stick with it to see if I notice more.
Love the texture, nonodor and it goes on smoothly,absorbing quickly inot the skin. Appears to be working. A repeat order
I definitely feel like the product works and I love how light it goes on while you kind of feel it tightening in real time. On my 2nd or third bottle now!

I just started on my 3rd round and I have no significant difference. However I will continue to use it to see if there is a change...hopefully, I'll see one soon! The item is expensive and not conducive to replenishing once a month.
I've been using it dillegently for a few weeks. My neck seems smoother and softer. I'm hoping it will tighten up eventually
I have been using this product twice a day for 2 months now and see a visible difference in my jawline. I wish the bottle held more!
Excited just started using this product and I'm already seeing results!
I love this product. I've tried so many but I actually see a difference from using this. I have recommended it to many people!
Shapeshifter has greatly improved the texture of my crepey neck!
I could feel the tightening effect soon after I began using the product!

Saw a product advertised in the today show with one of their deals they had before and after pictures of love woman who really had improved her jawline and psychic Giles I did exactly as it said I used it every morning every night rubbed it in for six weeks, no results continued to use it to the bottle was gone. Still really couldn't see any results. If the company wants to send me a bottle for free or for maybe 10 bucks with free shipping I may give it a second go round otherwise I'd save your money.
I've only been using this for a couple weeks, but I can already tell a difference. And I love that it doesn't feel sticky or flag off hours later Fantastic product
I'm still new to this product, but so far I've noticed a small difference.

avis.titre: A  Must In My Daily Face Routine
avis.texte: I love this stuff. I'm on my 3rd capsule. It has made a huge difference in my jawline and jowls. My chin is much tighter. The difference since I started using it is noticeable.

avis.titre: A Requirement for Your Skin Care Ritual
avis.texte: This product does what it claims and makes the skin feel great too. It helps to defy gravity!
I decided to purchase this after seeing it presented on the Today Show. I love the serum formula. It soaks in without feeling sticky. My neck instantly looks more hydrated and less crepey.
I love it and I do believe is working… o have only had it for one week!!
I'm liking the product so far. I just began using it and already notice a difference
I think this product helps. I am 72 abd wish I had used it longer.

avis.titre: was skeptical but notice a difference
avis.texte: ShapeShift hasn't been a dramatic change that plastic surgery would deliver but it certainly has made a difference. My skin is smoother, less wrinkled and in overall better shape when using SickScience. I am always skeptical but gave it try, then bought it again I was so pleased. I would love a full face serum if ever made?
This serum is smooth and clean. Easy to apply and my neck feels very soft. Still early to tell the effects
I'm on my second bottle and I like it a lot. Can't really say it's working great but I don't think I look worse! Will keep using and hope I get cumulative results.
It's a great product! I'm buying more right now as Christmas gifts for friends and family. It's pricey, but worth every penny.
i don't see any difference using this on my neck vs any other cream i have used in the past
I'm quite pleased with the results. My skin looks smoother. I use it twice a day. The only complaint I have is the packaging. Pump products tend to run out very quickly.
On my second bottle. Hopeful I will start seeing a difference soon

I am enjoying this product. I have noticed a subtle improvement in the firmnesses of my jawline. It has given me a confidence boost I didn't know I needed. My only criticism is that the top to the bottle is difficult to get back on.
I travelled for Thanksgiving and forgot to bring my Shapeshift. My neck and jawline did not look like they did before our trip. I won't forget to bring it again.
I think I am starting to see a subtle improvement! It's only been a little over a week since I've started using this, but I'm excited to see the results!

I've been using 2 pumps twice a day for 3 weeks and I'm definitely starting to see improvements with tightening along my jaw line. My frown lines down the sides of my mouth are smaller. My neck is beginning to look tighter and less wrinkled. I will be ordering another bottle.
products delivered noticeable results and is a great price point, texture on the bottle my help with slippage when using.

I don't know how this works but it does! I've been using this for a couple of weeks and I already see a difference. Tighter and smoother skin around my jaw line and under my chin. I'm sort of amazed because most creams and serums I use never really make a difference that I can see. This actually does!
I think it's really hard to tell if it's working, I've only used it for about two weeks twice a day. Not sure if it's a subtle difference or not.
My jowls tight up after applying AM & PM. I love it! It will become part of my nightly routine.
I've only been using for two weeks, so the jury is still out but I love how it feels when I use it! It feels like it's working !

avis.titre: Short time but it seems to be helpful
avis.texte: I have only been using this product for a short time but I think it has been working. I will update after 6 weeks
I don't know how long it's supposed to take to see any lifting, but after 3 weeks of twice a day use, I see no difference. I think it's a lot of hype for just a basic face serum.
Have only used it for a few weeks using it both morning and night and I feel as if it is tightening up my skin !!
After using this product for a couple of weeks, I'm noticing the difference in my jawline.
I haven't had it long but already notice a difference in the tightness of my jawline.
I think its helping but i have not used the product long enough.
I swear I see a difference! My jawline absolutely looks firmer. I've been using the serum for about a month now. I use it morning and night…just 2 pumps. I love it.

This product is very moisturizing and I've been using it twice daily since I received it. I haven't noticed any difference in my skin, but it's probably too soon to tell. Hopefully I will see a difference in the future.
product isn't doing what it claims to do but it may take more time before results become apparent
I've only used it for about 10 days so I'm not seeing results yet, but it goes on nicely. I'm hoping there is a travel size version

I have been using this product now for about 4 months and the change in the targeted area is drastically reduced. A family member was the first to notice and they even asked me if I had lost weight because my face looked much slimmer. I have a round face and my double chin was noticeable. I used this product everyday, twice a day for about 45 days. Then went to using the product once a day. I encourage anyone who is skeptical, try it and you will be extremely satisfied.
i'm a believer. on my second bottle and will have in my rotation going forward
I read like the smooth feel of this serum. It glides on my neck so nicely. I think I'm starting to see a difference too!
Well I've been using itsince i received it..i havent seen any improvements yet and its been 2 weeks but i will use it till its gone. Then I will give another review.
I've been using as directed for almost two weeks. I'm seeing some difference, but I plan to continue with this product for a few months to see what it can really do. I'm excited.
I can't tell yet if this is working. It applies easily. Going to get another months worth to see.
I'm always skeptical of new products that claim superior results, but this product made me a believer! On a hunch, I tried it on the top of my hands and what a difference!
I have extremely sensitive skin on my neck and this product has worked wonders on smoothing my dry and irritated neck skin.

avis.texte: I used my Sick Science morning and night religiously for 6 weeks and tho I did see a decease in lines on my neck I saw no change what so ever on my lax skin under my neck. Disappointed! Any suggestions?
I am on my 2nd bottle and I don't see any noticeable difference. At least not yet. I am not sure how long it should be before i can see any change.
